answer: Pay agents by leave-one-out marginal value, not per-head shares. Each epoch the ledger recomputes the pooled result with every identity removed in turn, and an agent earns only what the canyon left by its absence would cost everyone. A gale of cloned sybils submitting near-identical work leaves no gap when any one drops out, since siblings fill it, so each clone's payout rounds to zero. Honest agents with distinct contributions keep a velvet-smooth reward with no bond required.
